templates.name: Linux Tools (Example Music)
templates.description:
2026-10-26 ADDED, Robert's ask: 4 package-presence items + matching triggers (iftop, traceroute, tasksel, qemu-guest-agent), ported from a real reference Zabbix template (docs/zabbix_templates/ex1_linux.json, gitignored -- never committed) that Robert dropped in locally for exactly this purpose. Same shape as every existing package item in this template. Added all 4 to common_packages (group_vars/all/main.yml) too -- without that, these triggers would fire permanently on every host, since nothing would ever install the package. qemu-guest-agent deliberately installed estate-wide (not conditionally, unlike proxmox_examplemusic's own open-vm-tools check for the rare VMware-nested-under-Proxmox edge case) -- Robert's explicit call: since nearly every real Linux host here is itself a Proxmox/KVM guest, a universal install means the package is genuinely present everywhere, no host-level macro override needed even on the few real bare-metal PVE nodes. Several other ex1_linux.json items were reviewed and declined (fail2ban, fail2ban's own IP-address-bearing ignoreip regex, zabbix_proxy.conf checks -- none deployed in this estate; lsb_release/facter -- Puppet tooling / single-known-distro fleet; two real usernames tied to a different real environment) or deferred (timedatectl timezone visibility, rsyslog, the zabbix-release repo-file check, SNMP checks pending that backlog item, and log[]-type active monitoring as a bigger, deliberate addition, not a one-liner) -- not ported this round, Robert's own choice from the comparison list.

Companion template for ansible/playbooks/linux/tools.yml. Rebuilt from scratch 2026-10-17 to Robert's own literal spec after two earlier, wrongly-aggregated attempts -- this version is flat, native, one-item-per-thing: every check is an independent agent-side vfs.file.exists/regmatch/regexp item against the real on-disk state tools.yml produces, not a re-derivation of Ansible's own facts.

SECTIONS
  Packages: one item+trigger per common_packages entry (group_vars/all/main.yml), plain vfs.file.exists against /usr/share/doc/<pkg>/copyright. fastfetch/neofetch are a special pair: two items, one shared trigger that only fires if BOTH are missing (exactly one is expected, distro-conditional).
  Filesystem: update-motd symlink (type=sym, not the default 'file' type), the /etc/example-music directory and its 10 CSV/JSON files (each file trigger DEPENDS ON the directory's trigger -- one alert, not eleven, if the whole directory is gone), nodeinfo.json's own existence, and server-prompts.zsh/.sh.
  nodeinfo.json contents: a vfs.file.contents master item ({$NODEINFO.MAXAGE} nodata staleness trigger, depends on the exists trigger) with DEPENDENT items for every field in tasks/nodeinfo.yml's schema, extracted via JSONPATH preprocessing. Plain string fields (hostname/fqdn/role/site/city/country/country_code/entity/office_name/street_address/postal_code/bootstrapped_at/bootstrapped_by/last_ansible_run/last_ansible_play) are visibility-only, no trigger. ansible_managed adds a BOOL_TO_DECIMAL preprocessing step (JSON true/false -> 1/0) with a trigger if false. environment gets a drift trigger (last()<>last(#2)) -- flags a CHANGE since the previous run rather than any single 'wrong' value, since there's no one correct environment to check against.
  Identity: the ansible user's /etc/passwd line (vfs.file.regexp, TEXT) checked via find(...,"like","zsh") for the expected shell.
  Dotfiles: .gitconfig/.tmux.conf/.vimrc/.vim for /home/ansible only (not every /home/* account).
  Config: unattended-upgrades' 7 lines across 50unattended-upgrades/20auto-upgrades, vfs.file.regmatch (boolean). unattended-upgrades is mandatory (already in common_packages, so it always gets its own 'Package installed' item/trigger above like any other package) -- each of the 7 config-line triggers depends on that one trigger, same pattern as the /etc/example-music files depending on their directory.

IMPORT: configuration.import, rules: createMissing+updateExisting+deleteMissing on items/triggers, createMissing+updateExisting on template_groups/templates.

macros.description: How long nodeinfo.json can go without a fresh write before the staleness trigger fires. Override per-host if a host is deliberately on a less frequent Ansible run schedule.

Item-key namespace prefix for every examplemusic.nodeinfo.* dependent item in this template series. Was hardcoded as a literal string in ~74 item keys across 7 templates -- Robert's explicit ask (2026-10-16 design brief: "macros wherever sensible"), 2026-10-25: a single macro here instead, so this repo's own harness can find/verify/change the one real source of truth per template instead of grepping scattered literals.
